activity_summary: Later, at home, you heard that twenty are taken. You did not see it. The street door was not barred. The shutter stayed the bar she had already made.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard it, and did not claim to have seen it.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Brought the number from the stair, and did not bar the street door.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Stayed in, and was not asked to bar the door.

facets.activity: Heard that twenty are taken and stayed in

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: They are saying twenty are taken.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I did not see them taken.
